source_record.title: Working Student (m/f/x) - HR & Finance
source_record.description:
Our vision - your future

Cofinity-X is a joint venture founded in 2023 by BASF, BMW Group, Henkel, Mercedes-Benz, SAP, Schaeffler, Siemens, T-Systems, Volkswagen, and ZF. Established by industry experts, our company is primed for growth and is intended to be further led by professionals like yourself. 


Your mission

  • Provide administrative and operational support across our Support Functions teams including HR & Office, Finance, Procurement, and Legal
  • Assist with the coordination and maintenance of documentation, records, and internal systems
  • Support day-to-day business processes and help ensure tasks are completed accurately and on time
  • Coordinate meetings, stakeholder communication, and follow-up on action items
  • Prepare reports, presentations, and other business materials
  • Track deadlines and support ongoing projects and initiatives across different functions
  • Contribute ideas to improve processes, collaboration, and operational efficiency
  • Take ownership of ad hoc tasks and gain exposure to a variety of business topics and projects


Your profile

  • Currently enrolled at a university, ideally in Business Administration, Human Resources, Economics, Law, or a related field
  • Strong organizational and coordination skills
  • High attention to detail and reliability
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in German and English
  • Proactive mindset with a willingness to learn


Why us?

  • Free choice of hardware
  • Monthly lunch subsidy (up to 115 EUR)
  • Deutschland Ticket for environmentally friendly mobility options
  • Regular team events to strengthen cohesion and foster a positive working atmosphere
  • A modern office with an impressive view oft he Cologne Cathedral
